g.data-exception-reason: Single-height Index dot alternatives remain inside shared masters. Sample continuous contours near2mm pitch using1.2mm circles, preserving feature junctions and avoiding pairs under1.5mm centre separation. Jar lid perimeter and clipped interior grid form a filled band; body top row is reused at lid contact. Carton fold dots are sampled once and share existing junction dots. Bag handle remains an open contour attached to the body row. Native circles are provisional graphics layout, not measured hardware output.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse continuous geometry from each shared master. Lower grey container surfaces lie beneath higher black outlines. Jar lid stays a higher solid band. Carton front and flaps share one lower level, separated by a higher fold line; no extra level or perspective-depth claim. Bag body is lower, while handle remains a higher line around a white unraised aperture. These roles distinguish surface, boundary and functional opening, not natural colour or measured depth.
